climate_pressure: Stream drying attributed to climate change by FAO's May 2024 Ak-Bashat feature.
documented_impact: A farmer describes lost orchard water and switching toward cattle.
fcv_mediator: Competition over diminished local irrigation water and its distribution.
possible_consequence: The farmer describes disputes, including between friends; no violent outcome or prevalence is inferred.
alternative_explanations: Water demand, allocation rules and infrastructure can generate scarcity or disputes independently of climate.
uncertainty: Source-stated single farmer account in a 2024 agency feature; no representative sample, independent climate attribution or causal estimate.
resilience_factors: Other locations' sensor and storage examples are not assumed to have resolved Ak-Bashat disputes.
compact_statement: A 2024 Ak-Bashat farmer account links stream-water loss, livelihood change and disputes; the mechanism is illustrative and unquantified.
